24 years two months three days; at least 623 rescue methods; four Jugger ships; two days until mask production retained.
Zeta Hyades sixth planet second moon, VI-B notation, Beta Aquarii homeworld and base Beta Librae transfer preserved.
Voice ABOUT_US_3 retains 850.3, 937.2 and its omission of the Supox transfer. Voice TOO_LATE remains one line.
Voice OK_ATTACK_KOHRAH omits the base design/commander/Supox support and extra months passage. Voice NO_ULTRON_AT_BOMB stays its own two-line response.
Dynamic captain/alliance names remain insertions; name40 whitespace and name41 Empire fragment preserved.
